settings.heading: How long does it take to make my order?
settings.row_content: Every piece is crocheted to order. Crafting usually takes 3–7 business days depending on the size of the item and current demand. Larger pieces like blankets can take a little longer — we'll let you know if that's the case.

settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.row_content: Once your order ships, delivery usually takes 5–14 business days depending on your location. You'll receive a tracking number by email as soon as your parcel is on its way.

settings.heading: Can I order a custom piece?
settings.row_content: Yes! Custom colors, sizes and designs are our favorite projects. Contact us before placing your order and tell us what you have in mind — we'll confirm what's possible, the price and the timeline.

settings.heading: How do I care for crochet items?
settings.row_content: Hand wash cold with a mild soap, gently press out the water (never wring), and dry flat away from direct sunlight. With a little care, your piece will stay soft and beautiful for years.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: We accept all major credit and debit cards plus the express payment methods shown at checkout. All payments are processed securely — we never see or store your card details.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.row_content: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original condition. Custom-made orders are final sale. Please see our refund policy page for full details on how to start a return.
